# Smart Logistics Delivery Analysis and Optimization

## Project Overview
This project studies logistics delivery data to understand delivery performance, transportation costs, and factors that may affect operational efficiency.

The project is divided into four stages:
1. Strategic planning and data exploration
2. Data cleaning and preprocessing
3. Data analysis and visualization
4. Predictive modeling and optimization

## Week 1 Work
The first week focuses on defining the logistics problem, selecting performance indicators, planning the analysis process, and performing a basic exploration of the dataset.

## Dataset Columns
- Shipment_ID
- Distance_KM
- Delivery_Time_Hours
- Transportation_Cost
- Shipment_Weight_KG
- Vehicle_Type
- Traffic_Condition
- Weather_Condition
- Delivery_Status

## Tools Used
Python, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Scikit-learn.

## How to Run
Install Pandas and run:

```bash
pip install pandas
python week1_exploration.py
```

More analysis and machine learning work will be added in the following weeks.
